say: First write your one main message, and list the facts that support it, using only numbers you can check. Then choose the chart. A bar chart compares amounts across a few groups.

panel.heading: Pick the right chart

cards.d: Compare amounts across a few groups, such as sales of four products this month.
Show change over time, such as monthly savings from January to June.
Parts of one whole, with 4 to 5 slices at most.

say: A line chart shows change over time.

say: Charts can mislead, even by accident. A bar chart that does not start at zero makes small differences look huge. Missing units leave people guessing whether it is naira, people or percentages.
Run these five checks, then send the image to yourself on WhatsApp and check every word can be read without zooming.

panel.heading: Honest chart checklist
items: Bars start at zero
Units clearly labelled
Five slices or fewer
Source and date shown
One clear takeaway title

say: To remember. One message and one call to action. Hook, Value, Proof, Action, with only true claims. Honest charts. Story text in the safe zone. And test small before spending more.

panel.heading: Remember
items: One message, one hook, one call to action
Captions: Hook, Value, Proof, Action
Bars start at zero; show units and source
Stories: keep text in the safe zone
Test two small ads; keep the one that sells
